suggestions: I'm grateful for a pull request that got approved without a single back-and-forth comment.
I'm thankful for the mamak still being open when the craving hits at midnight.
I'm grateful for a power nap that actually ends when the alarm goes off, not an hour later.
I'm thankful for the quiet of the office right before everyone else logs on.
I'm grateful for a CI pipeline that's green on the first try for once.
I'm thankful for my mum's voice note reminding me to eat, even though I already ate.
I'm grateful for finding parking right outside the surau on a Friday.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of a bonus that covered exactly the bill I was dreading.
I'm grateful for a rubber duck debugging session that actually worked, even talking to an empty desk.
I'm thankful for nasi lemak that's spicy enough to wake you up properly.
I'm grateful for a manager who said take the day off and actually meant it.
I'm thankful for the first sip of air kosong after a long meeting that ran way over.
I'm grateful for an old laptop that held on for one more year before finally giving up.
I'm thankful for the group chat going quiet for a bit so I could actually finish a task.
I'm grateful for a taxi driver who knew a shortcut and got me home before the rain started.
